sections.heading: Do your kids love to hop, skip, and jump?
sections.html:
What if they could turn that joyful energy into support for one of their favorite places to play — Sunflower Creative Arts? Now they can!

On May 2, 2026, join us at John Prince Park (Eric Call Pavilion) for Hop, Skip & a Jump-A-Thon, a wildly playful walkathon for families of all sizes and ages.

Beginning at 9:30 AM, families will explore our PLAY + NATURE + ARTS 1/3-mile course filled with creative activity stations like hopscotch challenges, music-making, animal walks, and other joyful surprises along the way.

items.title: Jump
items.html: JUMP onto social media, text, or email and spread the word!

sections.heading: Prizes for top fundraisers
sections.html:
Funds raised will support Sunflower’s programs and creative learning experiences for children and families. And there’s a little friendly fun, too!

We’ll award prize packages to:

  • The registered family that raises the most money
  • The registered family with the highest number of donors

Full prize details coming soon.

sections.heading: Register your family
sections.html: We can’t wait to hop, skip, and jump with you in support of Sunflower Creative Arts!

sections.heading: Want to get even more involved?
sections.html:
Sponsorship opportunities are still available! If you own a business or know someone who does, this is a beautiful way to support Sunflower while connecting with our community.

Questions about the event or sponsorships? Feel free to reach out to Beth Harrelson, Development Director, at BethHarrelson@sunflowercreativearts.org.
